messages:
sylvia: Heads-up: PR #4720 is ready for docs review. Adds changelog for model-orbit deprecation, a short migration guide, updated python/js SDK snippets, and a note about kv-cache eviction for very long contexts. Also a param rename: response_mode -> output_mode. Need content + CI preview check.
rachel: I can take wording + links. tagging @dan for examples. ETA ~45m.
dan: I'll add the async python example and a concise JS streaming snippet. Any specific phrasing you want for the migration callout?
sylvia: prefer: 'scheduled removal on 2026-07-15' instead of "breaking soon". please link to the migration anchor once added.
ci-bot: Preview build for PR #4720 — status: failed. Missing anchor 'migrations#orbit' and one broken internal link. See /artifacts/4720/log.txt
dan: adding anchor and fixing the internal link. also normalizing python snippets to 4-space indent. pushing a tiny patch now.
dan: pushed fix: added migration anchor, corrected link path, adjusted python example formatting, and added the async streaming sample. cc @rachel
ci-bot: Preview built for PR #4720 — status: success. Diff summary: +1 migration anchor, +2 example lines, +3 snippet clarity tweaks, -1 ambiguous sentence in changelog.
rachel: content LGTM. one small ask: include a parenthetical recommending quantization profile (q4_0) for customers moving to the smaller replacement model; helps guidance.
sylvia: added parenthetical and noted SDK v4.0.0 where the output_mode rename lands.
zack: engineering review: validated compatibility and fallback behavior in staging; approved.
sylvia: merge timing: propose we merge after maintenance window on 2026-06-20 02:00 UTC. plan to merge at 02:10 UTC and run a 15-minute canary. objections?
eng-bot: Scheduled merge for PR #4720 at 2026-06-20T02:10:00Z by request of @sylvia. Canary window: 2026-06-20T02:10:00Z - 2026-06-20T02:25:00Z.
sylvia: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
